name: lua51
description: Lua 5.1, the Lua 5.1.5 release, built as C. Each feature is a departure from the stock build, made only when requested; cpp adds a C++ build beside the C one.

bitop.description: Builds Lua BitOp 1.0.2's bit library into each library and opens it in luaL_openlibs, as LuaJIT opens its own bit

cpp.description: Also builds lua51-cpp (lua51::lua51-cpp), the same library compiled as C++, so a Lua error raises a C++ exception rather than calling longjmp. Its API has C++ linkage. The C library, lua51::lua51, is built and installed as without the feature

int64.description: Makes lua_Integer long long on every target, in place of ptrdiff_t, which is 32 bits on a 32-bit target

luajit-api.description: Adds the C API calls past Lua 5.1 that LuaJIT 2.1 provides, under its names and signatures, and files package.preload in the registry under _PRELOAD, as LuaJIT does

tools.description: Builds the standalone interpreter, lua51. It runs lua51-cpp when cpp is requested, and lua51 otherwise; off Windows it exports the Lua API, for native modules that link no core
